findings.title: Windowed command lists cannot reach hidden rows with touch or mouse
findings.classification: New regression; source event-path reproduction plus independent pure geometry execution
reproduction: Use a touch-only session with safe-area size 844x354 (844x390 also reproduces). Open a record and the six-command hub from fresh focus 0.
ac04MenuLayout produces list height 202 and rowPitch 44: only rows 0..3 are instantiated. At 844x390 only rows 0..4 are instantiated.

The list root is a Frame; there is no wheel, drag, CanvasPosition, paging, or clickable-arrow handler. The down arrow is a TextLabel. Tapping any visible row cannot move focus outside the current window. STORY ARCHIVE/FLIGHT RECORDS are unreachable in the first size; FLIGHT RECORDS is unreachable in the second.

For an unlocked 18-mission archive at 390x808 only seven rows are instantiated; touch cannot reach mission 8 onward. Keyboard/gamepad can move focus and therefore shift the window. Mouse-only has the same missing scroll path.
findings.expected: All unlocked commands remain reachable on each supported input family.
findings.patchRecommendation: Use a native ScrollingFrame containing the command rows and synchronize CanvasPosition/focus, or add real 44px previous/next page buttons and touch/wheel navigation wired to onFocus/top. Preserve disabled mission rules. Test reachability, not merely containment of list rectangles.
findings.nativeStatus: Not run; exact visible counts computed from authored functions, missing event paths inspected directly.

findings.title: Flight Records no longer retries the failed save that the debrief tells players to retry
findings.classification: New regression; deterministic source request-path trace (no live DataStore fault injection)
reproduction: Start with records successfully loaded (recordsState ready). Complete a sortie while the cloud save fails; also fail the automatic post-result ListSlots save attempt.
The request failure deliberately preserves ready. Debrief displays the save error. Choose FLIGHT RECORDS after busy clears.

onRecords only invokes go(records), clearing the error; AC04RecordsScreen contains four selections and Back, with no refresh request. Selecting records or backing to the title makes no request. Since recordsState stayed ready, RETRY RECORDS is absent too.

The request trace for this promised recovery path is empty: the dirty server profile is never passed through ListSlots again by opening records. Baseline records had REFRESH RECORDS. Continue or another server operation may retry later, so this is a broken recovery instruction, not proof of permanent data loss.
findings.patchRecommendation: Add an explicit paced Refresh/Retry Save command to records and/or run ListSlots through operate on entry from result. Preserve last usable slots on errors, keep the retry action visible when a refresh/save failed after initial load, and update the persistence message from the successful retry rather than retaining result.saved=false forever.
findings.nativeStatus: No cloud access or runtime fault injection performed.

findings.title: Narrow speed instrument reserves only 10 pixels for its numeric value
findings.classification: New internal text-allocation defect; independent pure geometry execution, not native text measurement
reproduction: TagValue SPEED computes tagWidth=max(34,5*(11-1)+10)=60, then the numeric TextLabel width is 84-(60+14)=10, with TextTruncate.AtEnd.
844x354 similarly allocates 18 pixels (instrument width 92). 1280x684 allocates 56 pixels. The region-containment simulation does not inspect these children.
findings.patchRecommendation: Give speed a stacked label/value treatment on narrow layouts or budget instrument width from tag plus the maximum supported speed digits and measured native font bounds. Keep the central aim/touch lanes clear rather than simply widening into them. Check TIME and ALT child allocations in the same pass.
findings.nativeStatus: Exact clipping/truncation appearance and glyph widths were not observed. Require native screenshots and font bounds; the 10px allocation alone is reproduced.

keepoutRecommendation.status: Known gap, not a newly discovered regression. Proposed F1 is underspecified and its raw AbsolutePosition offset is inconsistent with the current controller coordinate convention.
patchReadySteps: Add a distinct custom-rect placement mode to FlightController; use readonly Rectangle[] in root-local rendered pixels plus anchor: GuiObject and root size, not a bare list with no coordinate contract. Keep legacy SetTargetKeepouts available; either setter clears the other mode and marks placement dirty.

UI supplies ac04HudKeepouts(ac04HudLayout(size.X,size.Y,input)), root frame, and measured root size in an effect for route flight. Clear the custom mode on flight unmount/route exit and UI cleanup. Preserve/mark dirty through controller.Start so the pre-start effect is not silently discarded.

In updateKeepouts compute origin=viewportOrigin(anchor), which adds GuiService.GetGuiInset() to AbsolutePosition. Shift each root-local rectangle by that origin exactly once; scale is 1 for this offset-based, unscaled UI. Pass TargetBoxes.Bounds(viewport.X,viewport.Y,{x:origin.X,y:origin.Y,width:root.X,height:root.Y}) to boxes.SetPlacement alongside those rectangles. Do not offset by raw AbsolutePosition or subtract the target ScreenGui origin: both overlay and selected cue consume viewport pixels.

Reuse per-frame origin/viewport comparison and dirty invalidation; setters must invalidate when dimensions, input mode or rect values change. Safe insets/rotation and root movement must refresh even if width/height stay fixed. Keep allocations out of each RenderStepped if placement has not changed.

Route both selected Fits/PlaceCaption and unselected Fits/PlaceTag through the same boxes placement already shared by FlightController and TargetBoxOverlay. Do not introduce a selected-only clipping API. ac04HudKeepouts currently excludes rearm, speed, altitude, heading, notice and alert: explicitly decide which occupied visible regions must also be reserved, especially the interactive pointer REARM button.

Do not change TargetBoxes.Tone, Selected, ranking or server Damageable/RequiredTarget/owner attributes. Required contacts retain priority/TGT tags; selected protected targets retain TRACK/HOLD and cannot become LOCKED. No new filtering of protected/required models, no changes to combat lock/LOS or world obstruction blockers. A visual keep-out hides/redirects a cue, never makes an obstructed or protected target damageable.

When a selected cue fails Fits, existing code uses the edge arrow. That arrow currently uses safeInsets/edgePoint, not custom keep-outs; test and if needed place that arrow in a free safe-edge segment as well, without losing the directional fallback. Do not move the target box off its projected target merely to fit.
